name: Sirnaomics Ltd.
summary: Sirnaomics Ltd., founded in 2007 and headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland, is an RNA therapeutics biopharmaceutical company developing innovative compounds for unmet medical needs in the United States and China. Lead assets include STP705, studied for skin cancers, liver cancers and scar remodeling, and STP707 for liver, lung and skin tumors and fibrosis. Its pipeline also covers other cancer, infectious disease, cardiometabolic and thrombotic programs.
